description: This Scala source file defines utility functions and classes for dependency management in Apache Spark, including Ivy properties, Maven dependency resolution, and file handling utilities.

classes.name: IvyProperties
classes.description: A case class holding Ivy dependency configuration properties.

methods.name: getIvyProperties
methods.description: Retrieves Ivy properties from system properties and returns an IvyProperties instance.

methods.name: resolveMavenDependencies
methods.description: Resolves Maven dependencies from a given Ivy URI.

methods.name: resolveMavenDependencies
methods.description: Resolves Maven dependencies based on provided parameters, including transitivity and exclusions.

methods.name: resolveAndDownloadJars
methods.description: Resolves and downloads jars specified by a string, returning local paths.

methods.name: addJarsToClassPath
methods.description: Adds jars to a class loader from a comma-separated list.

methods.name: downloadFileList
methods.description: Downloads a list of files to a temporary directory, returning local paths.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a remote file to a local temporary directory or returns local path if already local.

methods.name: resolveGlobPaths
methods.description: Resolves glob patterns in paths to actual file paths.

methods.name: addJarToClasspath
methods.description: Adds a local jar file to a class loader if it exists.

methods.name: mergeFileLists
methods.description: Merges multiple comma-separated file lists into one.

methods.name: splitOnFragment
methods.description: Splits a URI into its base and fragment parts.

methods.name: resolveGlobPath
methods.description: Resolves a URI glob pattern to actual file paths.
